description: Closest BEACON-style proxy supported by the current category-only meal dataset: dm_proxy = unique_items/total_items, mc_proxy = covered_required_categories/required_categories, uc_proxy = average per-item positive alignment, goodness = (dm_proxy + mc_proxy + uc_proxy) / 3.
source_stage_note: These published proxy outputs are computed by rescoring internally generated source bundles. The source-generation directory may be temporary and may not be retained in the GitHub-facing release.
